common.objective: Confirm the firewall rule narrowing closes the previously confirmed exposure while preserving admin access.

role_input.original_finding_ref: finding-001: firewall allowed TCP/3389 from any source to mgmt host 10.0.5.12, confirmed via successful connect from a disallowed source.
role_input.change_ref: patch-004: firewall rule narrowed to allow TCP/3389 to 10.0.5.12 only from the admin jump-host subnet 10.0.9.0/24.
role_input.independent_expectations: Only sources within 10.0.9.0/24 should reach TCP/3389 on 10.0.5.12; all other sources, including the originally successful disallowed source, must be refused; the admin jump-host itself must still connect successfully.

related_variations.description: Attempt from a second disallowed external source not used in the original finding
